cleanupGate: A new project is retained/delete-protected until separately reviewed owned cleanup. Never disable/delete existing account projects; empty owned project requirement and explicit protection disable apply.
excludedActions: Namespace create without new bound ProjectID
account/global admin API-key generation or reuse in test code

executionTransport.CLIRejectedReason: Cloud extension v0.2.1 constructs SDK options with default seven-retry policy. CLI is not the reviewed one-shot mutation transport.
executionTransport.credentialSource: explicit private OAuth config/profile; unexpired access token only, no API-key fallback or refresh
executionTransport.guard: private reviewed approval/request digest, exact OAuth identity/account preflight, fsynced exclusive before-dispatch tombstone, single-use per-transport-attempt authentication budget, no automatic process replay
executionTransport.outcome: safe new immutable project ID/async receipt or honest unknown with canonical gRPC code; never provider text or credentials

quotaGate: At most one new protected project; custom-project entitlement and available slots are unmeasured. A quota/feature error must stop, without enablement, support-setting changes or Default Project fallback.
requestMethod: CreateProject only; never UpdateProject or enablement
requiredOutcome: capture exact CreateProjectResponse.ProjectId and matching asyncOperation.id immediately into safe durable receipt
new ProjectID must be nonempty and differ from the protected existing project ID
GetProject by that exact new ID must match specification, delete protection, CreatedTime and creation operation evidence
pin immutable ID plus birth/resourceVersion/owner bootstrap receipt before constructing any Namespace Create request
no namespaces, API keys or service accounts are created by this project-only request
uniqueness: Display name includes full disjoint ownership/run digest. No account-wide display-name search is authorized or claimed; display name is mutable and never sufficient for adoption. Only the newly returned immutable ProjectID is a binding.

unknownOutcome.allowedRead: GetAsyncOperation only for this exact approved ID, and GetProject only if an independently returned new ID is known
unknownOutcome.fallback: Stop and retain the exact safe intent/unknown receipt. Exact same-request replay must be independently documented/proven before use; otherwise resolve through a separately approved provider/human evidence path. Never create a different project or use Default Project to hide uncertainty.
unknownOutcome.providerLimitation: Pinned AsyncOperation schema has input/state/times but no documented output/resource ID; a lost CreateProject response may leave the generated ProjectID unproven.
